title: Help Center: Duplicate Charges and Refunds (archived)
author: Dev Patel
body:
> Archived 2026-01-21. This help-center article is no longer current. Support handles duplicate charges as described on "Support Console: Duplicate-Charge Credits and Billing Disputes".

## Duplicate charges
If your invoice bills the same usage twice, contact Support with the invoice number. Support refunds a duplicated line in full on request.

## Refund timing
Refunds reach your card within 5-10 business days.
